purpose: Ames evaluation set disjoint from the TDC-derived benchmark, so that a model trained on that benchmark and a rule system are scored on the same rows.
normalization: toxicology.canonicalize_smiles: atom-map-free isomeric canonical SMILES. No salt stripping, neutralization or tautomer merging, so overlap across those forms is not detected and may remain.
limitations: Independence from ADMET-AI training data is established only for exact canonical structures present in the excluded benchmark, not for the model vendor's full training corpus, which is not published here.
Toxtree rule development may still overlap these labels; rule systems have no published training split to subtract.
Labels are taken from the source collection and are not independently verified.
